quirky.translation:
a. 诡诈的, 突兀的, 古怪的, 离奇的
[法] 诡诈的, 颇为曲折的

quirky best friend.definition:
Someone who is close pals with a conventionally attractive person. The quirky best friend is [unique], cute, [different]; usually [smarter] and more [artistic]. Not afraid to live life to the beat of a different drum.
> It's great being the quirky best friend of a model; she brings me to all the fun parties!

quirkyalone.translation: n. “乐单族”,指享受单身生活（但也不反对跟别人交往），而且宁愿单身也不愿意为了约会而约会的人。自2003年起，每年的2月14日被定为“国际乐单节”，用来“庆祝爱情、自由和个性”。

quiroga.translation: [地名] [阿根廷、玻利维亚、厄瓜多尔、墨西哥、西班牙] 基罗加

quirper.definition:
A man whose hobby it is to sniff the bicycle seats of females.
> Guy 1: My hobby is to sniff the bicycle seats of females
> Guy 2: Quirper!

quirt.definition: n. whip with a leather thong at the end
